The missing rule is `.claude/settings.local.json`. I’ll add that and cover `.env.*` files while allowing example templates. Entire also reports that checkpoint pushing is disabled, so its session history is currently staying local.

content.text:
Keep **shared configuration in Git** and **personal overrides and generated session data local**. Entire’s documentation follows this distinction for project and local settings. [Entire configuration documentation](https://github.com/entireio/cli#configuration)

For this repository:

| Keep tracked | Why |
|---|---|
| `.entire/settings.json` | Shared project configuration |
| `.entire/.gitignore` | Rules that exclude local Entire data |
| `.entire/agent-guide.md` | Repository workflow instructions |
| `.claude/settings.json`, `.codex/hooks.json` | Shared agent hooks |
| `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` | Project instructions |

| Keep local / ignored | Status |
|---|---|
| `.entire/settings.local.json` | Already ignored |
| `.entire/logs/`, `.entire/tmp/`, `.entire/metadata/` | Already ignored |
| `.entire/redactors/local/` | Already ignored |
| `.claude/settings.local.json` | **Added to `.gitignore`** |
| `.env`, `.env.*` | Covered; `.env.example` and `.env.*.example` remain trackable |
| Virtual environments, caches, notebook checkpoints, artifacts, downloaded data | Already ignored |

I updated [`.gitignore`](/Users/markcastillo/git/vector-masterclass/.gitignore:9) and verified that local files are ignored while shared configuration stays trackable. No currently tracked files match the ignore rules.

One distinction: **Entire checkpoint history is separate from `.gitignore`**. Your current Entire status reports checkpoint pushing disabled, with 123 unpushed checkpoints.

The `.gitignore` edit is local and uncommitted. The existing changes to `.claude/settings.json` and `.entire/agent-guide.md` remain untouched; those are shared configuration changes, not files that need ignoring.
I’ll review the remaining configuration changes, commit the shared setup and ignore rules, then push them to the private repository.
